# SOS Contractors & Trades

> SOS (Sales Operating System) helps trades and specialty contractors turn stalled quotes into booked jobs without more leads or more ads. Structure. Optimize. Scale. Built by Ryan James Miller.

## Who it is for
Founder-led specialty contractors and trades owners doing $250K to $30M who have hit a revenue plateau. Built for roofers, HVAC, plumbers, garage door, electricians, painters and more. Not for anyone looking for a course, a PDF or a shortcut.

## The problem it solves
You don't have a lead problem, you have a conversion problem. Quotes sit with zero structured follow-up, close rates swing, the sales process lives in the owner's head, and the owner is stuck in every deal. SOS calls this the Field-to-Office Gap: field credibility built the business but does not run a sales team.

## The system
Structure: document the process, define the pipeline, clarify the ideal customer. Optimize: install follow-up, train the team, measure what matters. Scale: remove the owner bottleneck. The Full Capture Scorecard grades three leak points: Total Visibility, Zero Cold Quotes and System Handoff.

## How it runs
- Full Capture Scorecard: free, 12 questions, about 4 minutes, three category scores and a first move.
- Pipeline Power System: a guided cohort covering pipeline stages, quote revival, follow-up cadence, scripts, tracking and team implementation.
- SOS Scale: a 90-day done-with-you engagement for established trades businesses ($1M+).
- SOS Pipeline Builders Network: a free Skool community with weekly frameworks, monthly live calls, win-sharing threads and quarterly spotlights.

## Results
- A local garage door company had 280+ dead quotes. SOS installed a seven-touch call, text and email sequence, and the company recovered nearly $52,000 in 30 days with no new leads or ad spend.
- A contractor with 47 open quotes revived five leads and closed two jobs, then installed a Day 3, Day 7, Day 14 follow-up sequence.
